_comment: Branch-protection payload for the FUL repo default branch. Origin: FUL-23 task 1; merge-policy resolved in FUL-34. Apply with ops/apply-branch-protection.sh (token needs repo-admin). NOTES: (1) required_status_checks.contexts must be the CHECK-RUN/job name 'baileys-sidecar-gate' alone, NOT 'baileys-sidecar-ci / baileys-sidecar-gate' (the 'workflow / job' form is unsatisfiable and made main permanently unmergeable). (2) required_approving_review_count is 0 because this is a single-GitHub-identity company (darshjme), who authors PRs and cannot self-approve; with 1 required review no agent could ever merge. The supply-chain control is preserved by the required status check (baileys-sidecar-gate) + require_code_owner_reviews on sensitive paths (CODEOWNERS). Raise count back to 1 once a second reviewer identity / Security team exists.
